decision: Selected the planar centroid of the boundary of Varde Kommune lokalplan 24.10.L03 'Sektorkoblet anlaeg ved Krageris, Olgod' in the national Plandata.dk register as the campus locator for atNorth DEN02, replacing the imported Olgod village point.
layer: Plandata.dk GeoServer WFS 2.0.0 layer pdk:theme_pdk_lokalplan_vedtaget, filtered by planid=12186922 and requested in EPSG:4326

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:25832 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.02 m

exclusions: The plan document on dokument.plandata.dk is disallowed by robots.txt and was not read. The address Kragerisvej 5B could not be geocoded because the open DAWA address service now answers HTTP 410 Gone, so the plan area, not the building address, is the locator. The plan area also covers the planned greenhouses that share the sector-coupled site. No geocoder, map viewport or village centroid is used.
